verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
In the secret, in the quiet place
In the stillness You are there

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
In the secret
In the quiet hour I wait only for You

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines: Cause I want to know You more

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
I want to know You
I want to hear Your voice

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines: I want to know You more

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
I want to touch You
I want to see Your face

verse.name: c1d
verse.lines: I want to know You more

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
I am reaching for the highest goal
That I might receive the price

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines: Pressing onward, pushing every hindrance aside, out of my way

verse.name: v2c
verse.lines: 'Cause I want to know You more
